def factor_range_vol_of_vol_ratio(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    range_ = df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]
    mean_range = range_.rolling(60, min_periods=20).mean()
    std_range = range_.rolling(20, min_periods=10).std(ddof=1)
    cv = std_range / mean_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    factor = -cv
    df_copy["factor_range_vol_of_vol_ratio"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_range_vol_of_vol_ratio"]
description: Captures volatility of range (vol-of-vol) as a mean-reversion signal. High volatility of daily range relative to its average level indicates unstable, erratic price formation; negative sign reflects expected subsequent compression and lower forward returns. This mechanism is distinct from level-based range compression and explores the dispersion of the range itself, an uncovered pathway in the Price-Volatility Behavior layer.
